blurb: Diving Sports Canada offers scuba diving and freediving equipment rentals, sales of dive gear packages, and maintenance services. They provide professional cold-water ocean diving gear rentals and scuba courses with cancellation policies. The shop is located in Vancouver and serves local and international customers.
